sources.title: Bank of Namibia — Monetary Policy
sources.supports: Monetary policy pursues price stability and an environment sustaining one-to-one Namibia dollar/rand parity.

sources.title: Bank of Namibia — Roles of the Bank
sources.supports: Common Monetary Area currencies including Namibia are pegged one-to-one to the rand; repo decisions signal policy direction.

authoring_rules: Do not construct an actual N$/rand appreciation or depreciation under the maintained peg. Use a third currency with a clear quotation, or state a hypothetical floating economy.
Interest-rate decisions support the peg. Do not assert unrestricted monetary independence or mechanically identical repo rates.
provenance: Primary institutional sources checked through web tools; contextual constraints, not additional examinable syllabus outcomes.
